newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul Exchange to list Sekerbank, Isuzu venture.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul Exchange to list Sekerbank, Isuzu venture.

text.p: The Istanbul Stock Exchange said it would on Thursday list on the national market shares representing 15 percent of the capital of Turkish Sekerbank and commercial vehicle joint-venture Anadolu-Isuzu.
For each 1,000 lira nominal-valued share, the opening prices will be 3,300 lira in Sekerbank T.A.S. and 57,000 lira in Anadolu Isuzu Otomotiv Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Both companies floated part of their capitals in separate public offers on April 3-4.
Sekerbank sold 300 billion lira of new shares to 11,527 domestic investors in last week's offer managed by TAIB investment.
The bank raised its capital to two trillion lira from previous 1.3 trillion by issuing 400 billion lira of bonuses and selling 300 billion lira of preemptive rights to the public.

The stakes held by Sekerbank's partners -- two foundations set up by the bank personnel, 27 sugar farm cooperatives and their union Pankobirlik and two state sugar factories -- fell slightly after the public offer.

Anadolu Isuzu offered 32.58 billion lira of new shares to the public in last week's offer managed by Inter Yatirim and Global Securities. Its capital went up to 217.195 billion lira from previous 184.615.

Foreign investors purchased 21.5 billion lira of the offer, 8,500 domestic investors bought 8.5 billion of it, Anadolu group employees got 1.6 billion and domestic institutional investors 980 million lira.

Anadolu Isuzu's major shareholders are Yazicilar Otomotiv and Ozilhan Sinai Yatirim of the Anadolu group which is active in brewery, automotive and stationery sectors, Japan's Isuzu Motors Ltd and Itochu Corp.

Yazicilar's stake fell to 35.7 percent after the public sale from previous 42 percent, Isuzu's share went down to 17 percent from previous 20, Ozilhan's dropped to 16.8 percent from 19.77 and Itochu's to 9.47 percent from 11.14.
